title: Infostealers in practice
intro: No password needed: a stolen session is enough. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: SenedYaz_Pro_Activator.zip
decisions.prompt: The archive from the channel is already downloaded. What do you do with this file?
decisions.explain: Deleting a file like this is the safest step, get the software the official way.

decisions.title: poct.idare.example
decisions.prompt: What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: A specialist can protect the account right away and see what was sent.

decisions.title: BlokDunyasi_Mod_Pulsuz.exe
decisions.prompt: Your daughter has downloaded a mod for a game. What do you do with this file?
decisions.explain: Get game add-ons only from the game's official store.

decisions.title: Sign-in from a new device
decisions.explain: The system marks the sign-in as suspicious, and technical support will see it.

decisions.title: Your computer was protected
decisions.prompt: A film site asked you to install a codec to watch the video. What do you do?

artifact.title: Your computer was protected
body: A program from an unknown publisher was not started.

decisions.explain: A site that needs a program to play a video is a trap, watch it somewhere else.
